summary: More community.general deprecations: sensu_check, sensu_client, sensu_handler, sensu_silence and sensu_subscription (use sensu.sensu_go), slack prepend_hash default changing from auto to never, and the yaml callback in favor of result_format=yaml in the default callback.
questions: What should I use instead of the community.general sensu modules?
How do I get YAML output without the yaml callback?
Will the slack module stop adding # to channel names?

answer_card.title: YAML output and sensu/slack deprecations
answer_card.answer_md:
- Instead of the `community.general.yaml` callback, use the builtin default callback with YAML output:

```ini
[defaults]
stdout_callback = ansible.builtin.default
callback_result_format = yaml
```

- The `sensu_*` modules (check, client, handler, silence, subscription) are deprecated. Use `sensu.sensu_go`.
- `slack`: the `prepend_hash` default changes from `auto` to `never` in 12.0.0.
